item.title: ＭＬＢ＝リーグ優勝決定シリーズ、レイズが2勝2敗の五分に戻す
item.description: ［クリーブランド １７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［クリーブランド　１７日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は１７日、ア・リーグ優勝決定シリーズ（７回戦制）第４戦を行い、レイズがガーディアンズに７─３で勝利。対戦成績を２勝２敗の五分に戻した。

レイズは一回に１点を先制されたが、三回に２番ジョナサン・アランダ一塁手の適時打で追い付くと、六回に４番フニオール・カミネロ三塁手の適時二塁打で２─１と逆転。続く七回、アランダのタイムリーなどで３点を追加した。この後２点を失ったものの、九回に１番ヤンディ・ディアス指名打者の２ランで突き放した。

２０２３年から２５年までプロ野球巨人でプレーした、ガーディアンズのフォスター・グリフィン投手は二回から２番手として登板。３回２／３、４安打１失点の内容で勝敗は付かなかった。

シリーズ第５戦は１８日に行われる。

item.title: Ex-Chihuahua attorney general accused of treason for allowing US participation in drug raid
item.description: Mexican authorities arrested former Chihuahua Attorney General Cesar Jauregui on suspicion of treason after an investigation found he may have allowed foreign personnel to participate in operations reserved exclusively for national security forces, Attorney General Ernestina Godoy said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexican authorities arrested former Chihuahua Attorney General Cesar Jauregui on suspicion of treason after an investigation found he may have allowed foreign personnel to participate in operations reserved exclusively for national security forces, Attorney General Ernestina Godoy said on Saturday. Prosecutors allege Jauregui allowed US agents to participate in an "irregular" raid on a suspected drug laboratory in April in the northern border state of Chihuahua without the authorization required under Mexican law. [USN:L4N4162EQ TEXT:"The US acknowledged"] in April that two employees of its embassy in Mexico City had died, without disclosing which agency they worked for. Sources familiar with the matter said the two were CIA officers involved in anti-narcotics efforts. The deaths rekindled sensitivities around US involvement in Mexican security operations. In the immediate aftermath, President Claudia Sheinbaum had sought to de-escalate tensions, reiterating that her government welcomes intelligence sharing and bilateral cooperation against organized crime but does not permit US agents or forces to participate directly in operations on Mexican territory. "The investigation determined that Cesar N may have engaged in conduct that could possibly constitute the crime of treason in matters of national security because he allegedly allowed foreign individuals to intervene without authorization on Mexican territory and take part in actions that correspond exclusively to national security forces," Godoy said in a video message on Saturday. Mexican authorities identified the suspect as "Cesar N," following the common practice of withholding a suspect's full surname during criminal proceedings. The arrest warrant was signed by a federal judge, Godoy said, adding that it came after months of investigations. Jauregui could not immediately be reached for comment and the US embassy declined to comment on Saturday.

item.title: Trabajadores de mina chilena Centinela ratifican nuevo contrato; cesa huelga
item.description: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos en huelga de la mina chilena de cobre Centinela ratificaron el preacuerdo logrado entre el sindicato y Antofagasta Minerals para un nuevo contrato colectivo, con lo que se pone fin a una huelga de más de una semana en el yacimiento, dijo el domingo la agrupación gremial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos en huelga de la mina chilena de cobre Centinela ratificaron el preacuerdo logrado entre el sindicato y Antofagasta Minerals para un nuevo contrato colectivo, con lo que se pone fin a una huelga de más de una semana en el yacimiento, dijo el domingo la agrupación gremial. Los más de 700 socios de Distrito Centinela y Minera Esperanza iniciaron el paro el 7 de octubre tras fracasar el diálogo contractual, donde pedían que los trabajadores tengan los mismos beneficios independientemente del sindicato al pertenezcan. Pero días atrás volvieron a la mesa de diálogo en un intento por encontrar una salida al conflicto. "Con profunda emoción y orgullo, los sindicatos Distrito Centinela y Minera Esperanza informamos el exitoso término de nuestra negociación colectiva, luego de que el 94,49% de los trabajadores que participaron en la votación aprobara la propuesta de contrato colectivo", dijo el sindicato en un comunicado. "Hemos conquistado la mayoría de nuestras exigencias acerca de igualdad y equidad, poniendo fin a años de diferencias e injusticias entre trabajadores de una misma compañía minera", agregó. Tres trabajadores habían mantenido una huelga de hambre en un intento por presionar una solución a las estancadas conversaciones entre las partes. Antofagasta afirmó en la semana que ha logrado sostener su producción en niveles normales lo que evitado los efectos negativos de la paralización. En 2025, Centinela produjo 240.400 toneladas de cobre. Además argumentó que durante los últimos días había presentado nuevas propuestas con materias relevantes y una mejora significativa en las condiciones económicas. La huelga en Centinela, además del riesgo finalmente no consumado de paralización de supervisores en Escondida, de BHP, ha estado apoyando los precios globales del cobre en medio de los temores sobre la dificultad de impulsar la oferta para abastecer el consumo estimado hacia adelante.

item.title: Rubio says Trump to take up to 60 days to weigh Russia sanctions
item.description: The waiver comes just weeks before November's midterm elections, with Trump under pressure over high energy prices as war with Iran disrupts global oil supplies.
item.dc:creator: Nandita Bose, Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: The day after waiving sanctions and tariffs related to Russian exports, US President Donald Trump said on Saturday he has yet to announce a final decision on the matter as Secretary of State Marco Rubio said officials want more time to evaluate the situation. Rubio said on Saturday that the president will use up to 60 days to assess the economic impact of Russia-related sanctions and tariffs that he waived a day earlier. "A lot of you don't know what my decision is yet, but we'll figure it out, and you'll figure it out," Trump told reporters at his Mar-a-Lago club in Palm Beach, Florida. The waiver comes just weeks before November's [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"], with Trump under pressure over high energy prices as war with Iran disrupts global oil supplies. Trump signed an executive order on Friday waiving key sanctions and tariffs under the law known as the Graham Act, which he signed last month at the urging of lawmakers who want to pressure Moscow over its war in Ukraine. The measures, including tariffs on Russian goods and penalties on countries buying Russian oil and gas, were due to take effect next week. Friday's order did not specify how long the waiver would last, but Rubio said Trump opted for a 60-day review. "I think the president wants to take the 60-day period of time to sort of analyze what imposing both sanctions and tariffs will mean to the global economy and even to the US economy," Rubio told reporters before boarding a plane for a trip to Uzbekistan. Complicating matters is the Graham Act's call not only for sanctions on Russia but also for tariffs on goods from countries that import Russian energy supplies. Rubio pointed to India, an important US partner that has diversified its energy supplies but remains heavily dependent on Russian oil. Friday's executive order [USN:L1N463009 TEXT:"drew criticism"] from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, who warned it would embolden Russian President Vladimir Putin and prolong the war. Senator Darline Graham, a South Carolina Republican whose late brother Lindsey Graham championed the legislation that bears his name, said she disagreed with Trump's decision and planned to discuss it with him when he campaigns for her next week. "Personally, I would choose to keep the pressure on Russia," she told reporters on Saturday. "Because I don't trust Putin and I don't trust Russia." DIESEL SUPPLIES Rubio also defended a separate US agreement with Russia to increase diesel supplies to global markets, aimed at easing fuel prices that have climbed amid the war with Iran and disruptions to energy supplies. Under the agreement, Trump said Russia initially would supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel to the United States, followed by shipments in November and beyond. "That diesel is going to be sold one way or the other," Rubio said. "The only difference is how much of it the United States was going to get." Rubio said the diesel deal and sanctions waiver reflected the challenge of managing conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine that have disrupted global energy supplies. "These conflicts around the world are starting to crash into each other," he said.

item.title: サッカー＝インテルがボローニャに逆転勝ち、開幕から無敗キープ
item.description: ［１７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１７日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイタリア・セリエＡは１７日、各地で試合を行い、インテルがボローニャに３─１で逆転勝利を収め、開幕からの無敗をキープした。

インテルは前半１０分に失点するも、同４４分にマルクス・テュラムのゴールで追い付くと、後半２４分にカルロス・アウグストが決めて逆転に成功。同３８分にも１点を加えた。

その他、ローマはジェノアに２─０で勝利し、ナポリはベネチアに０─１で敗れた。

インテルは７試合を終えて６勝１分けで勝ち点１９。２位ローマとの同２差をキープしている。

item.title: Jonathan Aranda's 3-hit night leads Rays past Guardians, ties ALCS 2-2
item.description: CLEVELAND -- Jonathan Aranda had three hits, drove in two and scored the go-ahead run on Junior Caminero's sixth-inning double as the Tampa Bay Rays evened the American League Championship Series with a 7-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians in Game 4 on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: CLEVELAND -- Jonathan Aranda had three hits, drove in two and scored the go-ahead run on Junior Caminero's sixth-inning double as the Tampa Bay Rays evened the American League Championship Series with a 7-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians in Game 4 on Saturday. The best-of-seven matchup is level at two wins apiece, guaranteeing that the series will return to St. Petersburg, Fla., for Game 6 on Monday. Game 5 will be played Sunday in Cleveland. Caminero doubled sharply to score Aranda in the sixth and give Tampa Bay a 2-1 advantage against Daniel Espino (0-1). The Rays tacked on three runs in the seventh, two of them on Aranda's single to right that Chase DeLauter misplayed for an error. Aranda came around for his second run on Chandler Simpson's sacrifice fly off Slade Cecconi later in the seventh, extending the Rays' lead to 5-1. Yandy Diaz added a two-run homer in the ninth off Matt Festa to push Tampa Bay's advantage to 7-3. Nick Martinez (1-0) pitched 5 1/3 strong innings for the win, allowing one run on two hits for AL East champion Tampa Bay. The right-hander struck out three and walked two, retiring 11 straight batters between the first and fifth innings. AL Central champion Cleveland pulled within 5-3 in the bottom of the seventh with a pair of runs against Ian Seymour. Travis Bazzana hit a solo homer and Brayan Rocchio later singled in Patrick Bailey, all with two outs. DeLauter gave the Guardians a 1-0 lead with a single in the first, bringing home Steven Kwan. Cleveland had failed to score in 13 innings against Martinez in the regular season, losing twice in two games. The Rays tied it at 1-1 in the third on Aranda's two-out single off Foster Griffin, scoring Diaz. Tampa Bay didn't have a hit in its first time through the order, but leadoff batter Diaz doubled in his second at-bat. Guardians star Jose Ramirez went 0-for-3 with a walk, extending his on-base streak to 16 postseason games and tying the Cleveland franchise record. The first-pitch temperature was 46 degrees. One night earlier, Cleveland experienced its first-ever postseason home rainout. --Brian Dulik, Field Level Media

item.title: Walsh surprised by 50m freestyle short course world record
item.description: American Gretchen Walsh said she had surprised herself by bettering her own short course 50 metres freestyle world record, adding that she was hoping to go even quicker at the world championships in Beijing this year.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: American Gretchen Walsh said she had surprised herself by bettering her own short course 50 metres freestyle world record, adding that she was hoping to go even quicker at the world championships in Beijing this year. Walsh's time of 22.75 seconds at the UVA SCM Pro Am in Charlottesville, Virginia on Friday saw her improve on her previous best mark of 22.83, set at the short-course world championships in Budapest in 2024. "A lot has happened since then, a lot of accomplishments, so I think yesterday's world record meant a lot more (than the previous record)," four-time Olympic medallist Walsh told SwimSwam on Saturday. "I've been training really, really well recently, and I think that I've been putting in really great work into the pool. So I knew that was going to pay off. "But the goal is to be breaking world records and doing all of this good stuff at the world championships in December in Beijing. I wasn't expecting a world record. I was really happy with that swim, and I'm really looking forward to resting and being able to go faster than that." In long-course swimming, Walsh owns the [USN:L4N41G023 TEXT:"100m butterfly record"] and was also part of world record-setting US teams in both the women's and mixed 4×100 m medley relays.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says helicopter crash in Najran kills two crew members
item.description: A reconnaissance AH-6i helicopter crashed in the Najran region of Saudi Arabia due to a technical malfunction, killing its two crew members, the Saudi-led coalition's spokesman Major General Turki al-Maliki said in a statement on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A reconnaissance AH-6i helicopter crashed in the Najran region of Saudi Arabia due to a technical malfunction, killing its two crew members, the Saudi-led coalition's spokesman Major General Turki al-Maliki said in a statement on Sunday. The helicopter crashed in an area under the jurisdiction of the Saudi National Guard Ministry, the statement added. The southwestern area of Najran has been subject to attacks by Iran-aligned Houthis in recent weeks as fighting between the coalition and the Yemen-based militant group escalated, with the [USN:L1N4620VJ TEXT:"Yemen conflict"] becoming another front in the US-led war with Iran . Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said in a post on X on Saturday that the group had shot down a Saudi Apache helicopter near Najran while it was carrying out what he described as hostile activities targeting Houthi positions along the border. Al-Maliki commented on Saree's post on Sunday with a photo of several Apaches lined up saying: "You claim to have shot it down, but it will enter the battlefield soon."

item.title: Agricultores estadounidenses se enfrentan a un nuevo desafío para sus cultivos debido al auge del sorgo en Brasil
item.description: Brasil ha duplicado con creces la producción de sorgo en los últimos cuatro años, y se prevé una mayor expansión. Rabobank estima que la producción podría alcanzar los 10 millones de toneladas métrica ...
item.dc:creator: Michael Hirtzer, Dayanne Sousa
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El creciente desafío que Brasil plantea a la agricultura estadounidense se está extendiendo a otro cultivo: el sorgo. Tras haber cedido ya el liderazgo a Brasil en la producción de soja y algodón, así como en otros productos agrícolas como la carne de vacuno, los agricultores estadounidenses corren ahora el riesgo de perder terreno en un cereal resistente a la sequía muy apreciado por los compradores asiáticos. Brasil acaba de enviar su primer cargamento de sorgo a China y está aumentando su producción para casi igualar la de Estados Unidos. Esto ocurre en un contexto de fricciones comerciales y una demanda de exportación errática que deja a los productores estadounidenses en una situación difícil durante la temporada de cosecha, lo que genera preocupación de que este cereal se convierta en la próxima víctima de un cambio generalizado hacia el suministro sudamericano. “Brasil no está tan rezagado con respecto a Estados Unidos en la actualidad”, afirmó Tim Lust, director ejecutivo de la Asociación Nacional de Productores de Sorgo, con sede en Lubbock, Texas. “Sin duda, han experimentado un rápido crecimiento en la producción de sorgo, al igual que en muchos otros cultivos”. Ver más: Los países donde más crecerán las exportaciones de bienes en América Latina en 2026, según la Cepal Estados Unidos también compite con Australia y Argentina, países que abastecen a China y que ocupan el segundo y tercer lugar a nivel mundial como mayores exportadores de este cereal. El reto para los agricultores estadounidenses es que el principal mercado de exportación de este cultivo ha sido también uno de los menos predecibles. China utiliza el sorgo principalmente para alimentar cerdos y elaborar el licor baijiu, y sus compras de este cereal estadounidense superaron los US$2.000 millones hace más de una década. Sin embargo, las exportaciones se desplomaron hasta aproximadamente US$186 millones en 2019 durante la guerra comercial inicial del presidente Donald Trump con China, y cayeron a tan solo US$86 millones en 2025. Actualmente, la demanda de importaciones en China sigue siendo débil debido a la abundante oferta nacional. Las fluctuaciones representan una señal poco fiable para los agricultores estadounidenses a la hora de decidir qué plantar. El sorgo, que suele ser una alternativa más barata al maíz, ya está siendo desplazado en estados como Nebraska por el maíz y la soja, que generalmente ofrecen mayores rendimientos y una base de demanda más amplia. Se prevé que la producción estadounidense caiga un 33% esta temporada con respecto al año anterior, debido a que los agricultores redujeron la siembra y la sequía en las llanuras del sur perjudicó los rendimientos. “Obviamente vivimos en un mundo competitivo, y esa es la realidad”, dijo Lust. “Por eso es mucho más importante para nosotros concretar estos acuerdos comerciales y poder crecer, producir y satisfacer las demandas del mercado de nuestros clientes”. El mes pasado, Lust envió una carta a Trump solicitando a la Administración que garantizara compromisos anuales para que China comprara entre 5 y 7 millones de toneladas de sorgo estadounidense. Según las listas publicadas por ambos países tras la cumbre celebrada en septiembre entre Trump y Xi Jinping, China reducirá los aranceles sobre el sorgo estadounidense, así como sobre el trigo y el maíz. Algunos agricultores, en cambio, buscan maneras de escapar por completo de la incertidumbre de los mercados de exportación. Brad Dusenbery cultiva unas 700 hectáreas en Nebraska y está construyendo un pequeño molino de piedra en Beatrice, en el sureste del estado, donde pretende producir harina de sorgo multiusos para elaborar productos que van desde galletas hasta panecillos para hamburguesas. Está haciendo la transición a métodos de producción orgánica y planea evitar depender de las exportaciones, ya que tiene pocas esperanzas de que el comercio sea estable. “Mi único objetivo es dejar el negocio de la exportación”, dijo. Mientras tanto, los agricultores brasileños se mueven en la dirección opuesta. El sorgo se ha popularizado como segundo cultivo en la región, sembrado después de la cosecha de la soja. El Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos afirmó en un informe el año pasado que este grano se adapta ampliamente al clima y las condiciones del suelo de diversas regiones de Brasil. Cuenta con el respaldo de importantes fabricantes de etanol como Inpasa Agroindustrial SA, el mayor productor de etanol del país, que recientemente ha puesto en marcha nuevas plantas capaces de procesar tanto maíz como sorgo. Brasil ha duplicado con creces la producción de sorgo en los últimos cuatro años, y se prevé una mayor expansión. Rabobank estima que la producción podría alcanzar los 10 millones de toneladas métricas para 2031, frente a los aproximadamente 6 millones de la temporada pasada. Esa producción en expansión ahora tiene una nueva e importante salida. La empresa estatal china de comercialización de productos agrícolas, Cofco International, cargó en agosto el primer cargamento de sorgo brasileño con destino a China, lo que alimentó el optimismo de que el país puede competir con Estados Unidos en el mercado global. “Ya se habla de que Brasil superará a Estados Unidos como principal productor mundial en pocos años”, dijo Frederico Botelho , investigador de Embrapa, la empresa estatal brasileña de ciencia agrícola. Según datos recopilados por la agrupación de exportadores ANEC, se prevé que hasta 2,4 millones de toneladas de sorgo salgan de los puertos brasileños este año hasta finales de octubre, principalmente con destino a China. Esto contrasta con la ausencia de envíos significativos en 2025. “China siempre ha dado señales de que no quiere depender de un solo proveedor y que desea diversificarse”, afirma Marco Castelli , director comercial de Agrobom, una empresa local de almacenamiento y comercialización de granos con sede en Minas Gerais. Esto significa que el mercado brasileño del sorgo tiene lo necesario para desarrollarse y crecer, añadió. “Para mí, este es un mercado que llegó para quedarse”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com Ver más: Comercio mundial sorprende al alza pese a los choques en Medio Oriente: estos países destacan en América Latina

item.title: テニス＝マスターズ上海大会、第1シードのズベレフ準決勝敗退
item.description: ［上海（中国） １７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［上海（中国）　１７日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスのマスターズ上海大会は１７日、シングルス準決勝を行い、第１シードのアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）は敗退した。

今季を世界ランキング１位で終えることが確定しているズベレフは第２５シードのアレハンドロ・ダビドビッチ・フォキナ（スペイン）に７─５、４─６、３─６で逆転負け。３６本のウィナーを打たれて２時間２分で屈し、同選手との８回目の直接対決で２敗目を喫した。

ダビドビッチ・フォキナはマスターズ１０００では準優勝に終わった２０２２年のマスターズ・モンテカルロ大会以来となる、通算２回目の決勝進出を達成した。

準決勝のもう１試合では、第１２シードのラファエル・ホダル（スペイン）がロシア出身で第５シードの元世界ランク１位、ダニル・メドベージェフに６─３、６─４で勝利。大会史上最年少、２０歳で決勝進出を果たした。同選手がマスターズ１０００の決勝に進んだのはこれが初めて。

item.title: Predators show versatility in scoring for win over Blues
item.description: Filip Forsberg scored his first goal of the season and added an assist for the Nashville Predators, who also scored on a penalty kill and a penalty shot in a 5-2 victory over the visiting St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Filip Forsberg scored his first goal of the season and added an assist for the Nashville Predators, who also scored on a penalty kill and a penalty shot in a 5-2 victory over the visiting St. Louis Blues on Saturday night. Jonathan Marchessault, Adam Edstrom, Ryan O'Reilly and Jack Drury also scored for the Predators. Steven Stamkos, Adam Wilsby and Roman Josi each recorded two assists. Juuse Saros made 24 saves for Nashville, which snapped a three-game winless streak (0-1-2). The Blues got goals from Philip Broberg and Jimmy Snuggerud. Mason McTavish, Jake Neighbours and Dylan Holloway added assists. Jordan Binnington stopped 19 shots for the Blues, who lost their second straight. St. Louis struck first thanks to a Predators turnover in their defensive end. McTavish kept Nashville from clearing the puck along the boards and fed Broberg, who notched his first of the season from the high slot with 13:39 left in the opening period. Nashville tied it with 11:20 elapsed when Binnington was called for throwing his stick at Marchessault. That set up a penalty shot for the Predators forward, and he beat the Blues netminder through the legs. That was the Predators' first penalty shot goal since Viktor Arvidsson scored one at Detroit on April 8, 2021. The Predators had missed their last seven. Forsberg, a 40-goal scorer last season, entered Saturday with a team-leading 22 shots on goal. He finally broke his season-long drought on a wraparound off a pass from Stamkos with 7:38 left in the first period, giving Nashville a lead it would not relinquish. Edstrom tallied his fourth goal and second short-handed goal of the season with 12:55 to go in the second period. However, Snuggerud responded 31 seconds later, snipping the Predators' lead back to one. St. Louis finished 1-for-5 on power play chances. O'Reilly extended his goal-scoring streak to three when he backhanded in his own rebound less than three minutes into the third. Drury, acquired in June from Colorado, scored his first of the season with 11:46 remaining, deflecting Josi's cross-ice feed into the net. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝バルセロナ5得点で圧勝、開幕から9戦全勝
item.description: ［セビリア（スペイン） １７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［セビリア（スペイン）　１７日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は１７日、各地で試合を行い、首位バルセロナがベティスを５─２で下し、開幕９戦全勝とした。

バルセロナは前半１０分、右サイドで仕掛けたラミン・ヤマルがペナルティーエリア右端から左足で先制。２─１で迎えた後半６分にはヤマルのお膳立てからガブリエル・ジェズスが決めてリードを広げた。

対するベティスは同８分にエズ・アブデのゴールで１点差に詰め寄るも、その直後の小競り合いでファクンド・ベルナルがヤマルに頭突きを見舞ったとして退場処分となり、１０人での戦いを強いられた。バルセロナはその後、ヤマルのＦＫのこぼれ球をエリック・ガルシアが決めると、最後はダニ・オルモが締めくくった。

佐藤龍之介が所属するバレンシアは、ビルバオとスコアレスドロー。佐藤はベンチ入りしたが出場はなかった。

その他、アトレチコ・マドリードはエスパニョールに１─０で勝利。ビリャレアルとエルチェはスコアレスドローに終わった。

９試合を終えて、バルセロナは勝ち点２７とし、２位アトレチコとの５ポイント差をキープ。ここまで計３９得点と圧倒的な強さを示している。

item.title: フランスの大規模抗議デモが一部暴徒化、近年最悪の暴動に 生活費高騰に不満
item.description:
Janis Laizans Stamos Prousalis Yann Tessier
[パリ １７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Janis Laizans　Stamos Prousalis 　Yann Tessier

[パリ １７日 ロイター] - フランス各地で１７日、生活費の高騰と公共サービスの質の低下に抗議するデモが一部で暴徒化し、同国で過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展した。

生活費の上昇を背景に、ベルギー、ポルトガル、イタリアでも同日、抗議デモが行われた。アルバニアでは、政府の腐敗への不満や雇用不足、教育水準の低さに抗議する人々が再び集まった。

フランスでは数十都市で数十万人が平和的に街頭行進する一方、一部の過激なグループが公共施設を標的にし、高級ブティックやスーパーマーケットを略奪し、警察車両や警官を襲撃した。

中部リモージュでは市庁舎が放火され、マルセイユでは黒ずくめのデモ参加者が市庁舎に乱入して無政府主義的な落書きをし、リヨンでは市の観光案内所が放火された。

ルコルニュ仏首相は、政府は暴力に「屈しない」と表明。騒乱は「極左」と犯罪者によるものだと非難した。

フランスでは２０２７年に大統領選が行われる予定で、同氏はＸに「この暴力を大統領選前の予行演習として利用しようとしている者たちに、はっきり言う。われわれは屈しない。誰であれ、暴力によって政治的な要求を押し付けることはできない」と投稿した。

同氏は夕方に現場を視察した際、抗議行動に関連して約１２００人を拘束したと述べた。

ヌニェス内相によると、全国のデモ参加者は約５５万人。仏労働総同盟（ＣＧＴ）はロイターに対し、参加者は８０万人と推計していると述べた。

マクロン大統領は、襲撃を実行した者を訴追し、処罰すると表明した。同氏はＸに「われわれの制度を損ない、平和的に要求を訴える人々を妨害することだけを狙う、混乱を引き起こす者たちに対し、われわれは一致団結して立ち向かう」と投稿した。

パリのデモ参加者、ローラさん（１９）は「私たちが声を上げているのは、生活費の負担があまりに重く、燃料価格が高すぎるからだ。高校生たちは、教員の増員やまともな学習環境を求めて抗議しているだけなのに、全国で暴力的な攻撃を受け、けがをしている」と語った。

＜催涙ガス、放火、略奪も＞

大半の抗議行動は正午ごろに始まったが、デモの正式な開始時刻より前に始まったものもあった。

パリの一部地区では、警察が若者を中心とするデモ参加者に押されて後退しながら催涙弾を発射した。参加者の多くは黒い服を着て、催涙ガスに備えてフードやマスク、ゴーグルを着用していた。暴徒たちは中心部の百貨店「ギャラリー・ラファイエット」への侵入を試み、銀行や店舗を荒らし、携帯電話会社の店舗を襲撃した。デモ参加者による放火は終日続き、多数の車などが燃やされた。

ベルギーのブリュッセルでは、フランスの抗議行動に触発されたとみられる若者ら数百人がデモを行い、一部が警察と衝突した。ベルギーの学生団体は、教育費の上昇と、高等教育を受けにくくする恐れがある改革に抗議していると説明している。

アルバニアでは、ラマ首相の辞任を求める学生の大規模デモが５日目に入り、警察が参加者に向けてゴム弾とみられる弾丸を発射した。

住宅費やその他の生活費への抗議行動が数日間続いているポルトガルでは、数万人がリスボンの街頭に繰り出した。ポルトガルの住宅価格は２０１７年以来２倍に跳ね上がり、住宅取得の困難さは欧州でも最も深刻な水準にある。

イタリアでは、ミラノで生活費の高騰に抗議するデモ行進が混乱に陥り、警察は催涙ガスを使用して中心部の大聖堂広場を制圧した。ＡＮＳＡ通信によると、ボローニャでは別の抗議デモが暴徒化し、警察が群衆を解散させるために放水車を使用。７人を拘束した。

＜仏警察の対応に批判＞

フランスの抗議行動は９月、労働者層が多いパリ北部郊外の高校で始まった。教員不足や施設の老朽化に対する怒りが、格差や公共支出、生活水準を巡る幅広い抗議運動に発展した。

パリでは１７日、蛍光ベストを着た抗議者たちが道路を封鎖した。フランスでは、マクロン大統領の一期目も「黄色いベスト運動」と呼ばれる抗議活動が起きたが、今回のデモ参加者数は当時のピーク時の規模を上回った。ただ、２３年の年金制度改革反対デモの規模には及ばなかった。

デモ参加者に負傷者が出たことを受け、警察の対応に批判が集まっている。警察の監察機関は、警察による暴力行為の疑いがある少なくとも２４件について調査を始めた。

ルコルニュ首相は、１７日の抗議活動で１５０人以上の警察官が負傷したと述べたが、デモ参加者に負傷者がいたかどうかについては言及しなかった。

ヌニェス内相は、１７日の警察との衝突で１人が片手を失ったとの報道を確認した。フランスのメディアによると、この人物は閃光手りゅう弾を拾おうとしたとされる。

警察労組ＵＮＳＡは、複数の場所で群衆がこん棒やれんがを使って警察車両を襲う映像をＸに投稿した。同労組は政府に対し、警察は限界に達しつつあると警告した。

item.title: Kent Johnson tallies in OT as Blue Jackets blank Rangers
item.description: Kent Johnson scored with 1:34 remaining in overtime as the Columbus Blue Jackets finally solved rookie goalie Dylan Garand and earned a 1-0 victory over the visiting New York Rangers on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kent Johnson scored with 1:34 remaining in overtime as the Columbus Blue Jackets finally solved rookie goalie Dylan Garand and earned a 1-0 victory over the visiting New York Rangers on Saturday night. After seeing his first three shots stopped by Garand and five other attempts blocked by the Rangers' defense, Johnson scored for the third straight game by teaming up with Charlie Coyle and Zach Werenski for the game-winner. As Columbus entered the offensive zone, Coyle moved past New York defenseman Sean Durzi near the right corner and spotted Werenski in the slot. Werenski quickly shifted the puck to Johnson, whose one-timer from above the right circle eluded Garand. Johnson's ninth career game-winner helped the Blue Jackets avoid a third straight loss after coach Rick Bowness described their effort in Tuesday's 7-3 setback to the Florida Panthers as "embarrassing." Columbus goalie Jet Graves made 29 saves for his fifth career shutout. He was flawless after allowing 11 goals in his first four appearances and made five saves on three New York power plays after permitting four power-play goals on Tuesday. Johnson scored after the Blue Jackets could not break the ice on a power-play opportunity in the opening minutes of overtime. Garand kept the game scoreless with a windmill glove save on Sean Monahan with one second left in the man advantage. Late in regulation, Garand made a diving skate save on Cole Sillinger and also denied Adam Fantilli, who recorded a team-high five shots. He finished with 28 saves. The Rangers' 21-year-old winger Gabe Perreault led all players with six shots. Garand's big performance was not enough to prevent the Rangers from consecutive losses for the first time this season, though he was significantly better than in Thursday's 7-1 loss in New Jersey when he was pulled after allowing four goals on 13 shots. --Field Level Media

item.title: Red Wings rally late, beat Sharks in shootout
item.description: Lucas Raymond had the only goal during a shootout as the host Detroit Red Wings topped the San Jose Sharks 4-3 on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Lucas Raymond had the only goal during a shootout as the host Detroit Red Wings topped the San Jose Sharks 4-3 on Saturday. Alex DeBrincat scored with 1:33 left in regulation to send the game into overtime. Emmitt Finnie had a goal and an assist, Justin Faulk also scored and Moritz Seider notched two assists for the Red Wings, who have won two in a row. John Gibson made 31 saves for the victory. San Jose star Macklin Celebrini racked up a goal and two assists, Dmitry Orlov and Ivar Stenberg supplied power-play goals and Stenberg added an assist. Alex Nedeljkovic stopped 24 shots for the Sharks, who fell to 1-2-1 in their past four games. With Gibson pulled for an extra skater, DeBrincat scored on a tip-in to tie the game at 3-all. Viktor Arvidsson and Seider had the assists. Detroit had to kill off an Andrew Copp penalty in overtime to force a shootout. The Red Wings cashed in on their first power play with 7:13 left in the first period. With Mason Marchment in the penalty box for interference, Faulk fired a shot from just inside the blue line that deflected off a defender's skate and past Nedeljkovic. Finnie and Michael Rasmussen picked up the assists. San Jose knotted the score with 2:01 left in the period on its second power play. With Ben Chiarot in the penalty box for holding, Orlov scored on a shot from the point. Stenberg and Celebrini collected the assists. Detroit defenseman William Wallinder turned the puck over in his own zone, allowing the Sharks to take the lead at 4:55 of the second period. Celebrini scored his third goal with a slap shot from the slot. Will Smith and Michael Kesselring had the assists. Both teams killed off a pair of penalties later in the middle period. With Red Wings defenseman Andreas Englund in the penalty box for tripping, San Jose made it 3-1 at 2:48 of the third. Stenberg scored in front off a feed from Alexander Wennberg. Celebrini notched the secondary assist. Finnie scored just over two minutes later, tapping in a Michael Brandsegg-Nygard shot attempt. --Field Level Media

item.title: Deaths confirmed after 'serious incident,' fire at Canada military base in Alberta
item.description: People were killed and injured in a serious incident that resulted in a fire on one of Canada's busiest military bases in Alberta, Defense Minister David McGuinty said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Amanda Stephenson
item.content:encoded: People were killed and injured in a serious incident that resulted in a fire on one of Canada's busiest military bases in Alberta, Defense Minister David McGuinty said on Saturday. "I'm saddened to share that there have been both fatalities and injuries as a result of an incident" at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, McGuinty told reporters in Ottawa. He did not say how many people were killed or injured, or what caused the "tragic" situation at the base in the east-central part of the province, about 210 km (130 miles) east of Edmonton. A major fire was still burning on Saturday evening, he said, adding: "I cannot recall an incident like this in recent memory." The Canadian military and the Royal Canadian Mounted Police are investigating the incident, McGuinty said. Prime Minister Mark Carney posted on social media that the national government was "working closely with the Government of Alberta and local authorities." CFB Wainwright had 1,310 military and civilian personnel stationed there as of 2021, according to census data. The town of Wainwright, population about 6,600, is just north of the base. The municipality posted on social media that the fire had crossed the base fence into the nearby district but no evacuation orders had been issued. General Jennie Carignan, the chief of Canada's Defense Staff, said on social media that the Canadian forces are fully engaged with federal, provincial and local authorities. "Our priority remains the welfare of our members, their families and their community," she said. (This story has been corrected to add the dropped word 'not' in paragraph 3.)

item.title: Cole Caufield scores in regulation, OT as Canadiens nip Sabres
item.description: Cole Caufield scored his second goal of the game 54 seconds into overtime, lifting the Montreal Canadiens to a 4-3 win against the visiting Buffalo Sabres on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Cole Caufield scored his second goal of the game 54 seconds into overtime, lifting the Montreal Canadiens to a 4-3 win against the visiting Buffalo Sabres on Saturday. Seconds after Josh Norris missed the net on a 3-on-1, the puck rolled down the left side and Caufield collected it to break in and beat Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen bar down. Zachary Bolduc and Alexandre Texier also scored for the Canadiens, who earned their third win in four games. Montreal's Juraj Slafkovsky and Alexandre Carrier each had two assists, and Jacob Fowler made 23 saves. Norris, Jack Quinn and Tage Thompson scored for the Sabres, who earned a point for the fourth consecutive game (2-0-2). Luukkonen stopped 30 shots. Thompson was uncovered at the right of the net to receive a cross-ice pass from Josh Doan and tie it 3-3 at 10:12 of the third period. Norris gave Buffalo a 1-0 lead at 8:21 of the first period. Konsta Helenius fired a shot from the top of the right circle for a redirect by Norris. Fowler made the save, but Norris stayed with it and snapped the rebound past the goalie from the right side of the net. Bolduc tied it on a power play on Montreal's first shot on goal, tipping a Nick Suzuki shot blocker side past Luukkonen at 11:45 of the first. Caufield made it 2-1 Canadiens less than three minutes later. Buffalo's Olen Zellweger went to retrieve the puck behind his net, but Slafkovsky used his reach to poke it over to Caufield, who quickly put it short side from the left of the net. Montreal capitalized on a faceoff win to push the lead to 3-1 at 7:39 of the second period. Phillip Danault won the draw, Bolduc collected it and fed it to Carrier, who quickly dished it to Kaiden Guhle at the left point. Luukkonen made the save, but Texier was right there to clean up the rebound and put it by Luukkonen's right pad. Quinn notched his first career short-handed goal to pull Buffalo within one. Zach Benson retrieved a loose puck near the left corner and zipped it to Quinn driving to the net, where he put it past Fowler's right skate at 9:52 of the middle period. --Field Level Media

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝ドラフト全体1位指名、ウィザーズのディバンツァが負傷
item.description: ［１７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１７日　ロイター］　 - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）ウィザーズは、今年のドラフトの全体１位で指名したフォワードのＡＪ・ディバンツァ（１９）が、１６日に行われたプレシーズン最終戦のペリカンズ戦で足首に軽度の捻挫を負ったと発表した。

ディバンツァはこの試合の第２クオーターにジャンプシュートを放った後、ぎこちない形で着地し、転倒。足を引きずりながらロッカールームへと下がった。約１５分プレーし、１２得点を挙げたが、ウィザーズは１０６─１０７で負けた。

ブライアン・キーフ・ヘッドコーチはディバンツァについて、大事を取って交代させたとコメント。同選手はさらに検査を受ける予定という。同選手はブリガムヤング大学で１年プレーし、全米トップの１試合平均２５．５得点をマークした。

ウィザーズは２１日に地元で行われるシーズン開幕戦でバックスと対戦する。

item.title: Flyers notch first win of season, Dan Vladar shines in goal vs. Senators
item.description: Matvei Michkov and Porter Martone each recorded a goal and an assist as the Philadelphia Flyers notched their first win of the season Saturday with a 3-1 home victory over the Ottawa Senators.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Matvei Michkov and Porter Martone each recorded a goal and an assist as the Philadelphia Flyers notched their first win of the season Saturday with a 3-1 home victory over the Ottawa Senators. Dan Vladar made 25 saves for Philadelphia, which went 0-6-3 in its first nine contests -- the worst start to a season in franchise history. The Flyers had not scored more than two goals in a game until Trevor Zegras' empty-netter sealed the game in the waning seconds. Ottawa netminder Linus Ullmark, who came into the contest at 6-0-0 on the year, suffered his first loss despite a steady 25-save effort. Drake Batherson tallied the only goal for the Senators. Neither team scored in the first period, although Ottawa's Dylan Cozens had a mini-breakaway opportunity that ended with the puck in Vladar's glove. The Flyers outshot the Senators 14-8 in the period -- a step forward for a Philadelphia team that has been outshot badly this season. Batherson opened the scoring at 5:55 of the second period with his fourth goal of the campaign. Claude Giroux carried the puck on a 2-on-1 and waited until the right moment to feed across to Batherson for the one-timer. About three minutes later, Philadelphia drew even on a nifty setup by Michkov, who found Martone driving to the net for a well-timed redirection. The score remained 1-1 until Michkov and Martone teamed up for the go-ahead tally late in the middle session. Martone created the opportunity on the power play, as his blast from the left circle led to a rebound that Michkov rammed home for a 2-1 edge. Ottawa had two good scoring chances early in the third. Nikolas Matinpalo found some space and took a hard shot that knocked off Vladar's mask. Shortly thereafter, Warren Foegele banged a rebound off the post from close range. With just over five minutes left, Philadelphia's Tyson Foerster was whistled for delay of game. Ottawa had a couple of quality scoring chances on the ensuing power play, but Vladar held firm. The Senators pulled Ullmark with about 2 1/2 minutes remaining. They threatened a bit down the stretch but could not get the equalizer, leading to Zegras' empty-netter with 14 seconds left. --Field Level Media

item.title: Stars stay hot with road shutout of Blackhawks
item.description: Arttu Hyry scored twice and Jake Oettinger stopped all 19 shots he faced for his third shutout of the season as the Dallas Stars beat the host Chicago Blackhawks 4-0 on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Arttu Hyry scored twice and Jake Oettinger stopped all 19 shots he faced for his third shutout of the season as the Dallas Stars beat the host Chicago Blackhawks 4-0 on Saturday night. Jason Robertson also scored and assisted on Roope Hintz's third-period goal, as the Stars improved to 4-1-1 since losing their first two games of the season. Hyry, who totaled three goals in 25 games spanning the past two seasons with Dallas, has already matched that total in eight games to open this season after recording his first career multi-goal contest Saturday. Meanwhile, Oettinger was hardly tested by Chicago, which went 0-for-4 on the power play. Oettinger, who didn't face more than eight shots on goal in any period, has allowed just six goals on 126 shot attempts while 3-2-1 on the young season. Dallas, which has yielded 12 non-shootout goals this season, has won 15 of the last 20 meetings versus Chicago. Spencer Knight made 28 saves for the Blackhawks, who lost for the first time in three games with star Connor Bedard back in the lineup from shoulder surgery. Bedard, who recorded three points in his first two games of the season, was held to two shots on goal Saturday. Dallas appeared to open the scoring with 7:50 remaining in the first period, but Robertson's goal was overturned upon a Chicago video review challenge for offside. However, Robertson was rewarded with the game's first goal at 4:58 into the second period, when he converted a give-and-go with Mikko Rantanen. The Stars made it 2-0 with 5:50 remaining in the middle frame. After Oettinger made an elbow save on a Chicago redirect, Dallas transitioned into a two-on-one where Sam Steel fed Hyry, who beat Knight on the rush. Then, amid a line change just 1:27 into the third period, Hyry took a stretch pass from Nils Lundkvist, broke in and sent a backhander past Knight. Dallas added more insurance with 10:20 remaining, when Hintz sent in a successful wrister from the circle through some traffic that appeared to screen Knight. --Field Level Media

item.title: Islanders get first road win of season as Leafs lose again
item.description: The New York Islanders secured their first road win of the season with a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The New York Islanders secured their first road win of the season with a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night. Anthony Duclair and Bo Horvat put the Islanders up 2-0 after 40 minutes and Simon Holmstrom secured the win with a pair of goals in the game's final six minutes as New York improved to 1-2-1 away from home. Horvat added an assist on Holmstrom's first goal and Ilya Sorokin continued his hot start, turning away 28 shots in his fourth win of the season. Sergei Bobrovsky stopped 16 of 19 shots for Toronto, which got a goal from Colton Sissons. Duclair opened the scoring 8:18 into the game. Jean-Gabriel Pageau pursued Toronto's Kirill Marchenko behind the net, recovered possession along the sideboards and fed Duclair in the slot, who placed his shot under the arm of Bobrovsky for his second of the year. Bobrovsky slid across the crease to deny Kyle Palmieri with a minute and a half left in the second, but Horvat chipped in the rebound between Bobrovsky and a sprawling Troy Stecher to make it 2-0. Both teams combined for just 12 shots in the middle frame. Sissons brought Toronto within a goal 3:54 into the third period, tipping in Stecher's low one-timer from the point. Both of Sissons' goals on the season have come against the Islanders. Little more than 10 minutes later, Horvat fed the puck to Holmstrom, who ripped the puck past Bobrovsky from the slot and halted a late offensive surge from the home team. Holmstrom followed up with an empty netter with just over two minutes remaining. With John Tavares out week-to-week (lower-body injury), Nick Paul slotted in at center on the Maple Leafs' second line. Islanders forwards Matias Maccelli and Calum Ritchie both left the game with injuries in the first period. New York's forward corps may be stretched even thinner in the ongoing absence of Mathew Barzal. Toronto has allowed three goals or more in seven consecutive games and has lost three straight. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝チェルシーＧＫマルティネス、脳震とうで病院に搬送
item.description: ［リバプール １７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［リバプール　１７日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、チェルシーのＧＫエミリアノ・マルティネス（３４）は１７日、エバートン戦で相手選手と衝突して脳震とうを起こし、病院に搬送された。

マルティネスはゴール前でＦＫに対応しようとした際、エバートンのジャラッド・ブランスウェイトと激突。ブランスウェイトは治療を受けた後に立ち上がったが、マルティネスは地面に横たわったまま治療を受けたのち、担架でピッチから運び出された。

チェルシーのシャビアロンソ監督は「脳震とうということ以外は分からない」とした上で、「彼は搬送されたとき意識はあり、今は病院で念のため検査を受けている。重傷ではないことを願っているが、待つしかない」と述べた。

後半３０分からマルティネスに代わり、２１歳のＧＫマイク・ペンダースが出場。プレミアリーグデビューを果たし、チームにとってリーグ戦では１月以来となる完封に貢献した。チェルシーはペドロ・ネトが２ゴールを挙げ、２─０で勝利した。

item.title: Argentinos Juniors gana a Banfield y trepa a cima de tabla anual del fútbol argentino
item.description: Argentinos Juniors venció el sábado 1-0 en su visita a Banfield y quedó en la cima de la tabla anual del fútbol argentino junto con Boca Juniors a falta de tres jornadas para el final.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Argentinos Juniors venció el sábado 1-0 en su visita a Banfield y quedó en la cima de la tabla anual del fútbol argentino junto con Boca Juniors a falta de tres jornadas para el final. Argentinos llegó a 54 puntos en la sumatoria general, misma cantidad de Boca, en busca de uno de los títulos de la temporada del fútbol argentino. Ambos aprovecharon el empate de Independiente Rivadavia, que quedó escolta con 53 unidades. En el partido disputado en el estadio Florencio Sola de Banfield, el gol del triunfo lo anotó el ingresado Matías Giménez Rojas a los 66 minutos tras una gran jugada individual. "Una felicidad enorme porque todo el año venimos peleándola y este es el resultado. Nos quedan tres finales. Hay que salir campeón, porque hace dos o tres años Argentinos viene llegando lejos hasta el final y no puede coronar, ojalá podamos ahora", dijo Giménez Rojas a la televisión local. Por su parte, en el estadio Bautista Gargantini de la provincia de Mendoza, Tigre sacó un empate agónico 2-2 en su visita a Independiente Rivadavia y bajó a su rival del liderato de la tabla anual. Los goles del conjunto mendocino los anotaron Matías Fernández y el paraguayo José Florentín, mientras que para Tigre convirtieron Alan Barrionuevo y Manuel Fernández. "Tanto en este partido como en el anterior con Gimnasia La Plata se nos escapan cuatro puntos en los últimos minutos del partido. Queda un sabor amargo", dijo en conferencia de prensa el director técnico Alfredo Berti. En otros partidos disputados el sábado, Vélez Sarsfield ganó 1-0 a Gimnasia y Esgrima de Mendoza, mismo marcador con el que Lanús venció a Platense, mientras que Rosario Central superó 3-2 a Atlético Tucumán. El viernes, Boca Juniors ganó 2-1 a Talleres de Córdoba, mientras que Instituto de Córdoba superó 1-0 a Defensa y Justicia. La jornada comenzó el jueves con el triunfo 2-1 de Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata sobre Huracán.

item.title: サッカー＝イプスウィッチ前田、マンＣ戦でプレミア初ゴール
item.description: ［ロンドン １７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ロンドン　１７日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは１７日、各地で試合を行い、イプスウィッチの前田大然がマンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）戦で同リーグでの初ゴールを挙げた。

先発した前田は先制された２分後の前半２１分、右サイドで味方からのパスに追い付き、左足でシュート。開幕から７試合目で待望の初得点をマークした。この後アーリング・ハーランドに２ゴールを決められたイプスウィッチは、後半４５分にＰＫで１点を返したが、２─３で敗戦。前田は後半２６分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶が所属するアストンビラはニューカッスルに１─０で勝利。鈴木はフル出場を果たし、今季初の完封勝利に貢献した。リバプールはブレントフォードに２─１で逆転勝ち。リバプールの遠藤航はベンチ入りしたが、出場しなかった。

守田英正が所属するハルはフラムに０─１で敗戦。守田は後半３０分から出場した。チェルシーはエバートンに２─０で快勝した。

開幕７連勝のマンＣが勝ち点２１で首位。チェルシーが同１３の４位、リバプールが同１２の暫定５位に浮上した。ハルは９位でイプスウィッチは１０位。今季２勝目を挙げたアストンビラは暫定１２位に上がった。

item.title: サッカー＝バイエルン6ゴール圧勝で暫定首位浮上、伊藤は出番なし
item.description: ［ミュンヘン（ドイツ） １７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ミュンヘン（ドイツ）　１７日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは１７日、各地で試合を行い、伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンがライプチヒを６─１で下し、暫定首位に浮上した。

ホームのバイエルンは前半１２分にルイス・ディアスのゴールで先制すると、前半のうちに３─０とリードを広げ、後半にも立ち上がりの２分にディアスが加点。同８分には、これがブンデスリーガ通算１００試合目の出場となったハリー・ケーンがゴールを挙げ、最後はディアスがハットトリックを達成した。失点は同アディショナルタイムに喫した１点のみだった。

伊藤はこの試合でベンチ入りしたが、最後まで出番はなかった。

佐野海舟がフル出場したマインツは、田中聡フル出場のシャルケに１─０で勝利。マインツの川崎颯太はベンチ入りしなかった。

ドルトムントがウニオン・ベルリンと０─０のドローに終わったため、６試合消化段階でバイエルンが勝ち点１４でドルトムントと並び、得失点差により暫定首位に浮上した。

item.title: ボクシング＝亀田和毅のタイトルマッチ、相手の体調不良で当日中止に
item.description: ［１７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１７日　ロイター］ - プロボクシングの亀田和毅（３５）は１７日、米ラスベガスで世界ボクシング協会（ＷＢＡ）世界フェザー級タイトルマッチを行う予定だったが、対戦相手の体調不良により、試合当日に中止となった。米ボクシング専門サイト、ボクシングシーンなどが報じている。

ブランドン・フィゲロア（２９、米国）は１６日の前日計量で規定体重（５７．１５キロ）を２回クリアできず、体重超過でタイトルを剥奪されていた。１回目の計量では約０．６キロのオーバー。１時間後に行われた２回目の計量でも体重は減っていなかった。

亀田はこの試合に勝てば新王者となり、引き分けか負けた場合、王座は空位となる予定だった。亀田の戦績は４２勝５敗。フィゲロアは２６勝２敗１分け。

item.title: Florida State RB Ousmane Kromah carted off with ankle injury
item.description: Florida State running back Ousmane Kromah was carted off with an apparent left ankle injury during the second quarter of Saturday's game at No. 3 Miami.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Florida State running back Ousmane Kromah was carted off with an apparent left ankle injury during the second quarter of Saturday's game at No. 3 Miami. Kromah was headed for the corner of the end zone when he was tackled from behind by Miami linebacker Chase Smith. As he went to the ground, Smith's ankle caught below Him and twisted awkwardly. Kromah got up and tried to hop off the field before going to the ground as the Seminoles' medical staff rushed to treat him. His left leg was placed in an air cast before he was carted to the locker room. Kromah entered Saturday as Florida State's leading rusher with 565 yards and five touchdowns on 100 carries. Kromah had 44 yards on 14 carries on Saturday night before the injury. --Field Level Media

item.title: Carter Verhaeghe’s natural hat trick helps Panthers rout Kraken
item.description: Carter Verhaeghe scored a natural hat trick as the Florida Panthers made NHL history in an 8-3 rout of the visiting Seattle Kraken on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Carter Verhaeghe scored a natural hat trick as the Florida Panthers made NHL history in an 8-3 rout of the visiting Seattle Kraken on Saturday. The Panthers became the first team in NHL history to record natural hat tricks -- three consecutive goals by one player -- in three straight games. Brady Tkachuk accomplished the feat in Florida's previous two outings. Sam Bennett also tallied three times, while Niko Mikkola and Sam Reinhart each had a goal and an assist. Matthew Tkachuk had three helpers, and younger brother Brady Tkachuk added two for the Panthers, who won their third in a row. Goaltender Jacob Markstrom made 20 saves. Shane Wright, Frederick Gaudreau and Ryker Evans scored for Seattle, which finished a five-game trip with a 3-1-1 record. Berkly Catton and Kaapo Kakko each had two assists and Joey Daccord stopped 29 of 37 shots. Bennett opened the scoring at 1:05 of the first period before Wright tied it at 4:54. Verhaeghe snapped a 1-1 tie at 17:56 of the first. The puck squirted free after a battle along the left wing boards and came straight to Verhaeghe just inside the left faceoff dot. He put a one-timer over Daccord's shoulder and into the far upper corner of the net. Verhaeghe tallied again at 19:07 on the power play. The Tkachuks won the puck along the right wing boards and Brady got control in the corner. He took a stride toward the net before firing a pass across the top of the crease to a wide-open Verhaeghe, who lifted the puck over Daccord as the goalie moved from post to post. Verhaeghe scored his third at 6:02 of the second period. Mikkola was stopped on a wraparound attempt but Verhaeghe secured the rebound just outside the left post and slid the puck past the downed Daccord to make it 4-1. The Kraken played without defenseman Brandon Montour, who sustained a lower-body injury Thursday in a 4-3 overtime loss to Tampa Bay. Montour was a member of the Panthers' Stanley Cup-winning team in 2023-24. Mikkola scored just 40 seconds after Verhaeghe completed his hat trick, and Bennett added his second goal at 13:13 of the second period to extend Florida's lead to 6-1. Gaudreau scored for Seattle with 55 seconds remaining in the second period, but Reinhart answered with a power-play goal at 2:25 of the third. Evans cut the deficit to 7-3 at 3:49 before Bennett completed his hat trick at 11:14 to close the scoring. --Field Level Media

item.title: ゴルフ＝竹田は首位と5打差の4位、ビュイックＬＰＧＡ
item.description: ［１７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１７日　ロイター］　 - 米女子ゴルフのビュイックＬＰＧＡは１７日、中国・上海の佘山国際ＧＣ（パー７２）で第３ラウンドを行い、竹田麗央は前日の４位をキープした。

竹田は４バーディー、１ダブルボギー、１ボギーの１アンダー７１で回り、通算４アンダーの２１２。ＬＰＧＡツアー初優勝を目指す、首位チェ・ヘジン（韓国）とは５打差となった。

４０位でスタートした吉田優利は６バーディー、１ボギーの５アンダー６７をマーク。通算イーブンパーの９位で、ディフェンディングチャンピオンのジーノ・ティティクル（タイ）らと並んだ。

４位で出た原英莉花は７６とスコアを崩し、通算１オーバーの１４位に後退。勝みなみは通算７オーバーの４０位、西郷真央は通算８オーバーの４６位となった。

item.title: Ryan Blaney’s pole run at Phoenix sets up major Chase opportunity
item.description: AVONDALE, Ariz. -- Score one for the drivers in hot pursuit of Chase leader Kyle Larson.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: AVONDALE, Ariz. -- Score one for the drivers in hot pursuit of Chase leader Kyle Larson. In qualifying for Sunday's 312-lap Freeway Insurance 500 at Phoenix Raceway (3 p.m. ET on USA, MRN and SiriusXM NASCAR Radio), Ryan Blaney claimed the pole position with a lap at 137.143 mph (26.250 seconds). Blaney is one of five drivers closest to Larson in the Chase presented by Mobil 1 standings, and those five drivers earned the top five positions on the grid for Sunday's race, while Larson qualified a disappointing 22nd in Saturday's time trials. Blaney, who is going for his third straight Phoenix win, is fifth in the race for the NASCAR Cup Series title, 85 points behind Larson. His Team Penske teammate, Joey Logano, qualified second at 136.926 mph, 0.032 seconds off Blaney's pace. A four-time Phoenix winner, Logano is sixth in the Chase standings, 92 points in arrears. Joe Gibbs Racing Toyota drivers Chase Briscoe (136.825 mph), Denny Hamlin (136.809 mph) and Christopher Bell (136.617 mph) qualified third through fifth, respectively. Hamlin is second in the standings, 49 points back, with Bell trailing by 51 in third and Briscoe by 65 in fourth. Briscoe is seeking his third straight win in the Chase, having triumphed at Las Vegas Motor Speedway and Charlotte Motor Speedway. Accordingly, Sunday's race presents a golden opportunity for those chasing Larson both to score stage points and compete for a crucial victory. "It's really, really important, just from our side, to put yourself up toward the front early in the race, try to get some points early and try to keep track position," said Blaney, who claimed his fourth Busch Light Pole Award at Phoenix, his fifth of the season and the 17th of his career. "Job one done today, so I'm proud of everybody for doing a good job and taking that first step, and then a whole new challenge tomorrow. Hopefully, we can keep going." Blaney also posted the best single-lap speed in Saturday's practice, covering the one-mile distance in 26.969 seconds (133.487 mph). Three-time series champion Logano described his current Chase position as "pretty desperate." "If we want to win the championship, this race in particular is one that we have circled and has been good for us," he said. "If we're going to make up 90-plus points in four races, you have to win. "It's a must-win scenario and probably multiple times to do that, so if we want to win this whole thing and do it without wishing bad luck upon somebody, then we're going to have to win." Tyler Reddick and Ty Gibbs will start sixth and seventh, as Toyota drivers claimed positions three through seven on the grid. Michael McDowell is the fastest non-Chase driver in eighth, followed by non-Chaser Josh Berry in ninth and Chase driver William Byron in 10th. It's worth noting that in the last 18 Cup races at Phoenix--from 2017 through the entire Gen 7 era--no winner has started deeper in the field than 13th, and all but three winners in that span have started in the top 10. Larson was dissatisfied with the balance of his car throughout the day. He was 13th fastest in practice and 12th in best consecutive 10-lap average. item.title: Woodside natural gas project unit paused after Greenpeace protest off Western Australia
item.description: Woodside said operations remained paused on Sunday at a floating production unit, part of its $12.5 billion Scarborough natural gas project off the coast of Western Australia, due to a Greenpeace protest at the platform.
item.dc:creator: Samuel Mckeith
item.content:encoded: Woodside (WDS.AX) said operations remained paused on Sunday at a floating production unit, part of its $12.5 billion Scarborough natural gas project off the coast of Western Australia, due to a Greenpeace protest at the platform. Two activists from the environmental advocacy group slept overnight on the semi-submersible unit, located around 375 km (233 miles) off the state's northwest coast, in the [USN:L4N46300J TEXT:"protest"] that started on Saturday, Greenpeace said. "Temporary hanging tents" were set up on the unit and the activists would "occupy the platform for as long as possible," Greenpeace said. The group is concerned about the potential impact of Woodside's proposed Browse project on Scott Reef, a remote coral system and foraging area for the endangered pygmy blue whale. Woodside has said it expects no physical contact with the reef above the 75-metre (246-foot) water depth. A Woodside spokesperson said "operations at the Scarborough FPU remain safely paused" on Sunday, a day after temporarily halting pre-commissioning activities as a result of the "unauthorised access". Four activists on Saturday scaled the 70,000 metric ton unit, part of the 98% completed Scarborough project, and displayed banners with the message "Stop Woodside’s Dirty Gas. Save Scott Reef", according to Greenpeace. Australian Border Force on Sunday said it had no update on the incident. It previously said it was working with federal and state agencies on a response.

item.title: US wants Israel to 'crack down' on settler violence in West Bank, Rubio says
item.description: The United States wants Israel to do more to deter attacks committed by settlers in the West Bank, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United States wants Israel to do more to deter attacks committed by settlers in the West Bank, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday. "We're very disturbed by those images and what we're seeing," Rubio said. "We've asked the Israelis and continue to ask them to crack down on that stuff." His comments to reporters came after the widespread dissemination of video showing multiple individuals attacking Heidi Levine, an American photojournalist with the Washington Post. Levine was one of at least two people injured in the Friday incident, which took place as Israeli settlers [USN:L6N46304S TEXT:"attacked"] Palestinian civilians. European diplomats and a French mayor also were attacked in the occupied West Bank, Belgium's foreign minister said. The US State Department, Rubio said, has inquired about the event that included Levine's attack. Rubio, who spoke to reporters before boarding a flight to Uzbekistan, said he expects to hear back from the US Embassy in Jerusalem by Sunday. Israeli settlers in the West Bank have been involved in at least 170 attacks on Palestinians since September 27, around the start of the annual olive harvest, according to Yesh Din, an Israeli settlements monitoring group.

item.title: Report: Bears QB Caleb Williams to start vs. Falcons
item.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams is expected to return to the starting lineup Sunday against the Falcons in Atlanta after missing the previous three games with a hamstring injury, ESPN and NFL Network reported Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams is expected to return to the starting lineup Sunday against the Falcons in Atlanta after missing the previous three games with a hamstring injury, ESPN and NFL Network reported Saturday. Williams, who has been sidelined since injuring his right hamstring against the Minnesota Vikings on Sept. 20, practiced fully throughout the week without a setback. The Bears officially listed Williams as questionable Friday, but he handled first-team work and continued to progress through the final two practices of the week, according to the reports. Coach Ben Johnson said Friday that Williams was "on track" after the quarterback increased his workload. Chicago went 2-1 without Williams. Case Keenum started a Week 3 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles before Tyson Bagent led the Bears past the New York Jets in Week 4 and started last week's loss to the Green Bay Packers. Williams has completed 36 of 55 passes for 407 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in two games this season. He also has rushed for 107 yards and two scores. The injury ended a run of 36 consecutive regular-season starts for Williams dating to the beginning of his NFL career. His return sets up the first NFL meeting between Williams and Atlanta quarterback Michael Penix Jr., two of the six quarterbacks selected in the first round of the 2024 NFL Draft. Chicago took Williams first overall, while the Falcons selected Penix at No. 8. Penix also dealt with an injury this week after hurting his ribs in Atlanta's Week 5 loss to Baltimore. The Bears (3-2) will try to rebound from their loss at Green Bay against the Falcons (2-3). --Field Level Media

item.title: Lightning rally from 2 down to beat Canucks
item.description: Jake Guentzel scored the tiebreaking goal in the third period as the Tampa Bay Lightning kept their home slate clean with a 4-2 comeback win over the Vancouver Canucks on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jake Guentzel scored the tiebreaking goal in the third period as the Tampa Bay Lightning kept their home slate clean with a 4-2 comeback win over the Vancouver Canucks on Saturday afternoon. Guentzel, who also had an assist, gave Tampa Bay its first lead at 2:04 of the third period when his long shot deflected off the stick of Vancouver's Liam Ohgren for his fourth goal of the season. Pontus Holmberg added an insurance goal with just over four minutes left as the Lightning improved to 5-0-0 at home by potting four unanswered goals. Nikita Kucherov tallied twice, and Brayden Point had two assists. Goaltender Dennis Hildeby made 12 saves. Linus Karlsson and center Elias Pettersson netted for the Canucks, who finished 0-5-1 on their East Coast road trip. Goalie Kevin Lankinen, who entered with a 6.88 goals-against average, stopped 31 shots. As the Florida Panthers did against Vancouver on Thursday, Tampa Bay controlled play and generated early scoring chances but struggled to beat the opposing goalie. Vancouver did not register its first shot on Hildeby until Elias Pettersson put one on goal at 6:53. In his club's best chance early, Guentzel had a wide-open cage on an odd-man rush, but Lankinen stretched out and made a sprawling kick save at 9:02 to keep it scoreless. Just after a Kucherov penalty for tripping expired, Filip Chytil worked the puck behind Hildeby's net and found Paul Cotter, who delivered an off-balance pass to Karlsson. The winger scored his second goal of the season at 15:32 to give the Canucks a 1-0 lead. On Vancouver's second power play, Pettersson made it 2-0 with a shot from nearly no angle to Hildeby's left. The attempt caromed in off the goalie at 4:35 for Pettersson's third tally of the year. Kucherov answered less than two minutes later on the Lightning's first power play of the game and added another right off a faceoff nearly five minutes later to knot it 2. The score remained tied through 40 minutes despite the Lightning holding a 26-12 advantage in shots. --Field Level Media

item.title: Packers place WR Skyy Moore, two others on IR
item.description: The Green Bay Packers placed wide receiver Skyy Moore and defensive tackles Javon Hargrave and Jonathan Ford on injured reserve Saturday in advance of the team's game against the visiting Dallas Cowboys on Sunday night.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Green Bay Packers placed wide receiver Skyy Moore and defensive tackles Javon Hargrave and Jonathan Ford on injured reserve Saturday in advance of the team's game against the visiting Dallas Cowboys on Sunday night. All three players previously had been ruled out against Dallas and now must miss at least four games under NFL injured reserve rules. Hargrave suffered an Achilles injury late in Sunday's 31-7 victory over the Chicago Bears and is expected to miss the remainder of the season. Moore has a high ankle sprain and Ford a calf injury. Moore has seven catches for 35 yards in five games this season for Green Bay (3-2). In other moves Saturday, the Packers activated wide receiver Savion Williams from IR and elevated defensive end Arron Mosby and wide receiver Coleman Owen from the practice squad. Williams has not played this season but caught 10 passes for 78 yards and a touchdown in 12 games for the Packers last year. --Field Level Media

item.title: Seattle Reign lose young star Maddie Dahlien (knee) for rest of season
item.description: Seattle Reign FC placed forward Maddie Dahlien on the season-ending injury list Saturday after she suffered an ACL tear while training with the United States' under-23 women's national team.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Seattle Reign FC placed forward Maddie Dahlien on the season-ending injury list Saturday after she suffered an ACL tear while training with the United States' under-23 women's national team. Dahlien, 22, has three goals and four assists in 25 appearances for Seattle this season. The assists tie her for the team lead. She was one of three finalists for NWSL Rookie of the Year in 2025. "We're heartbroken for Maddie, and our priority is making sure she has the support and resources she needs throughout her recovery," Seattle general manager Lesle Gallimore said in a news release. "She has made a tremendous impact on this club in just two seasons, and her competitive drive, determination and work ethic are evident in everything she does. We're confident she'll approach this challenge with that same mentality and come back stronger." Dahlien was a member of North Carolina's 2024 national championship team in college and quickly excelled with Seattle. She had four goals and four assists in 2025. Dahlien made three appearances with the U.S. women's national team earlier this year. She earned her first cap in January against Paraguay. During this month's under-23 training camp, Dahlien started in a 5-0 victory over the Dominican Republic on Oct. 9 in Fayetteville, Ga. Four days later, she entered in the 58th minute and left 16 minutes later as the U.S. beat the Dominican Republic 6-2, also in Fayetteville. --Field Level Media

item.title: Hurricanes win 7th straight, defeat Jets
item.description: Nikolaj Ehlers scored the go-ahead power-play goal in the third period as the Carolina Hurricanes rallied for their seventh straight victory, defeating the host Winnipeg Jets 3-2 on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Nikolaj Ehlers scored the go-ahead power-play goal in the third period as the Carolina Hurricanes rallied for their seventh straight victory, defeating the host Winnipeg Jets 3-2 on Saturday. Ehlers put Carolina ahead 3-2 with a power-play slap shot from the high slot at 6:43 of the third period for his first of the season. Mark Jankowski and Jesperi Kotkaniemi also scored, and Shayne Gostisbehere had two assists for the Hurricanes. Pyotr Kochetkov made 21 saves and improved to 5-0-0 on the season. Mark Scheifele and Alex Iafallo scored for the Jets, who have lost two straight games and three of their last four. Clay Stevenson made 34 saves. The Jets outshot the Hurricanes 10-8 in the first period. Carolina didn't register its first shot on goal until the 5:26 mark. Scheifele put Winnipeg ahead 1-0 at 4:23 of the second period on a backhanded shot. It was also the Jets' first shot of the period and extended Scheifele's points streak to five games. Jankowski tied the game 1-1 at 8:19 when Logan Stankoven set him up for a wrist shot through traffic on the power play. Iafallo gave the Jets a 2-1 lead at 10:59 when Adam Lowry intercepted Kochetkov's attempt to play the puck behind the net and set him up for a tap-in. Kotkaniemi knotted the score back up 2-2 at 16:50 when he tipped in Gostisbehere's shot from the blue line. Overall, Carolina won 55.2% of the faceoffs, and they outpaced Winnipeg in takeaways 6-4. Most importantly, they put a lot more pressure on the net with 37 shots compared to the Jets' 23 attempts. The Jets have now lost back-to-back games; they suffered a 4-3 overtime loss to the Chicago Blackhawks on Thursday. They will travel to St. Louis to take on the Blues on Tuesday. Meanwhile, Carolina is scheduled to face the Calgary Flames on the road on Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.title: WNBA Commissioner Engelbert says successor needs 'thick skin'
item.description: WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert said on Saturday her successor will need to have "very thick skin" to navigate the job as she prepares to retire at the end of the year.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert said on Saturday her successor will need to have "very thick skin" to navigate the job as she prepares to retire at the end of the year. Engelbert announced her [USN:L6N44W0YL TEXT:"retirement"] last month after seven years in the role during which she guided the league through a historic labor agreement and massive franchise expansion. "It's like a multidimensional role. You have to have very thick skin," Engelbert told a press conference in San Francisco, ahead of Game 1 of the WNBA Finals between the Golden State Valkyries and Atlanta Dream. "You have to have confidence that we can continue this growth trajectory and confidence in building relationships with players and agents and the Board of Governors, the owners and the stakeholders." Engelbert said the league has hired a search firm to find her replacement and there has been a lot of interest in the job. She also offered advice to her successor about the next steps for the league. "When I came in, the first question I had was ... what's our strategy?" she said. "We did a very simple three-tiered strategy, which was player first, stakeholder success and fan engagement, fan experience. "I would say that strategy has worked. And now you do have to evaluate whether there's other aspects of that where we really need to broaden our platform. "I would tell the next commissioner that we've got to continue that and get into a sustained growth period at the league office. Then the teams are still in hypergrowth, and support the teams in their growth objectives because teams have grown a lot."

item.title: Venezuela expects nearly $76 billion in oil investment over five years, acting president says
item.description: Venezuela expects nearly $76 billion in oil investment over the next five years under recently signed agreements, acting President Delcy Rodriguez said on Saturday, adding that a bilateral accord with the US includes plans to drill 250 rigs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Venezuela expects nearly $76 billion in oil investment over the next five years under recently signed agreements, acting President Delcy Rodriguez said on Saturday, adding that a bilateral accord with the US includes plans to drill 250 rigs. Since the January ouster of President Nicolas Maduro, the country has been reopening its energy sector to foreign investment with the backing of the administration of US President Donald Trump. The deals could help revive output in Venezuela, which has the world's largest proven crude oil reserves but produces well below levels seen a decade ago. Rodriguez said on national television the investments would bring direct benefits to Venezuela while also benefiting its partners, adding that the bilateral agreement with the US covers 17 oil fields and formed part of a broader package of 61 agreements signed by the parties. "Major investments are coming," she said. "We are talking about investment of almost $76 billion over five years. Those investments will translate into direct benefits for our country in a win-win partnership, because our partner will also benefit." Rodriguez also highlighted a recovery in oil production in western Zulia state. There, production rose from 70,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 370,000 bpd, she said, adding it was expected to reach 400,000 bpd by the end of the year. She did not say over what period the increase occurred. Venezuela's oil output has suffered from years of underinvestment, operational problems at state oil company PDVSA and US sanctions on the energy sector.

item.title: Knicks waive veteran G Bruce Brown
item.description: The New York Knicks waived guard Bruce Brown on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Knicks waived guard Bruce Brown on Saturday. The veteran wing appeared in all 82 games for the Denver Nuggets last season, averaging 7.9 points, 3.9 rebounds, 2.1 assists and 1.0 steals while shooting 38.5% from 3-point range. The 30-year-old is best known for his contributions to the Nuggets' championship team in the 2022-23 season. He has had stints with the Detroit Pistons (2018-20), Brooklyn Nets (2020-22), Nuggets (2022-23, 2025-26), Indiana Pacers (2023-24), Toronto Raptors (2024-25), and New Orleans Pelicans (2025). Brown signed an Exhibit 9 contract with the Knicks in September. He was waived as part of a final roster crunch. Notably, former No. 2 overall pick James Wiseman made the roster. The 25-year-old center also signed an Exhibit 9 deal in September. --Field Level Media

item.title: Two killed, including 6-year-old, when truck drives through Kansas youth soccer game, police say
item.description: A truck drove into a youth soccer game in Wichita, Kansas, leaving a six-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man dead, and 10 others hospitalized with traumatic injuries, police said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Karen Freifeld, Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: A truck drove into a youth soccer game in Wichita, Kansas, leaving a six-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man dead, and 10 others hospitalized with traumatic injuries, police said on Saturday. The injuries ranged from minor to severe, but none appear to be life threatening, Wichita police Captain Aaron Moses said at a news conference. The two people killed were pronounced dead at the scene, he said. Moses said a 34-year-old woman was driving the truck, which ended up in a field at the west end of the Stryker Sports Complex. She has been cooperating with investigators, he said, but when asked whether she had been arrested, he said only that she was in custody. "We know what happened, but now we're working very hard to find out why it happened, and we're not there yet," Wichita police Chief Joe Sullivan said. The injured include two youths aged 5, two aged 8, a 9-year-old and five adults, police said. In addition to those 10 people, one adult was hospitalized for non-traumatic medical issues. The driver had a child playing soccer at the complex, but not on the field where the incident took place, Moses said. The truck involved had two juveniles as passengers, he said. Emergency dispatchers started getting calls about the incident at 3:25 p.m. local time (2025 GMT), Moses said. "Today is a heartbreaking day for Wichita," Mayor Lily Wu said. "Families came to Stryker Sports Complex to enjoy a Saturday afternoon, watching their children play soccer and no one could have imagined the tragedy that would unfold."

item.title: Dubois defeats Wardley in short order to retain WBO heavyweight title
item.description: 'Dynamite' Daniel Dubois retained his WBO heavyweight belt with a one-sided and devastating second-round stoppage of fellow Briton Fabio Wardley in their world title rematch on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: 'Dynamite' Daniel Dubois retained his WBO heavyweight belt with a one-sided and devastating second-round stoppage of fellow Briton Fabio Wardley in their world title rematch on Saturday. The 29-year-old champion made a storming start at London's O2 Arena and Wardley's legs went from under him for a count within 17 seconds of the opening bell as Dubois floored him with a straight right. Wardley, 31, beat the count and could have been stopped at the end of the first round when he took a further brutal pounding on the ropes but was saved by the bell. There was no escape from the onslaught of blows in the second with Dubois picking up where he left off and Wardley taking punch after punch until the towel was thrown in and referee Steve Gray brought the fight to a close. "Fabio is a great warrior, coming in for a second time, but it was my time and my era," said 'Triple D', never a man for long speeches. "I had my intentions, bad intentions, from the beginning. "Our back was against the wall the first time, this time we just had to go out there and show that we mean business and that's what we did tonight." HRGOVIC READY TO PUT HIS TITLE ON THE LINE Dubois dealt Wardley his first defeat as a professional when he came back from two knockdowns, the first after 16 seconds, to take the title in the 11th round of a thunderous and bloody clash [USN:L6N41M07R TEXT:"in Manchester last May."] Wardley, promoted to WBO champion last November after Ukraine's Oleksandr Usyk vacated the title, was acclaimed for his courage and refusal to give in first time around but on Saturday he looked a shell of the man seen in Manchester. He now has a 20-2-1 record with Dubois on 24 wins with three defeats. "I've always thrown myself in with the best competitors out there, the toughest, the biggest, hardest, meanest guys around. There's no shame in testing yourself against the best," he said. "Daniel's a testament to coming up short and coming again, I'll be looking to do the exact same thing. "Boxing is a game of fine margins. It can be done and over in a round or two or it can go into a big old war like it was last time." Dubois was previously the IBF champion, [USN:L1N3TG065 TEXT:"losing it to Usyk in London in July last year"] before coming back to take the WBO belt from Wardley. Croatian Filip Hrgovic, [USN:L6N44Q078 TEXT:"the IBF champion after beating Britain's Moses Itauma in August,"] was ringside on Saturday and challenged Dubois to a fight with both belts on the line. "It was an easy night for Daniel. He did a good job, quick win. So he's ready to fight me in March, right Daniel?," said Hrgovic, before promoter Frank Warren suggested he might have to deal with other candidates first. Dubois beat the Croatian in June 2024 to take the interim IBF belt and was then upgraded to champion when Usyk vacated his title. "I want to have a rematch with him, I want to get my old belt back and rule the division," said Dubois.

item.title: Las “potencias medianas” se enfrentan a nuevas estrategias de supervivencia bajo el mandato de Trump
item.description: El desafío al que se enfrentan las potencias medianas, a menudo descritas como naciones con influencia global, pero sin estatus de superpotencia, se ha agudizado en los últimos años.
item.dc:creator: Dan Strumpf, Rebecca Choong Wilkins
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Un orden mundial cambiante, marcado por la interrupción de las cadenas de suministro y la inestabilidad de las alianzas, está obligando a los llamados países de potencia media a trazar nuevas vías de supervivencia. Países como India, Canadá y el Reino Unido se enfrentan al reto de cómo desenvolverse mejor en un mundo en el que la intensa competencia entre Estados Unidos y China, las guerras en curso y la explosión de la inteligencia artificial han provocado cuellos de botella que comprimen las cadenas de suministro de energía y tecnología.
